_description: Evaluation V3 for Minimalist Chat. It preserves all 50 V2 judgments and adds 50 source-grounded questions covering real user phrasing, code behavior, authority conflicts, visual history, negative/source-leakage checks, and citation-oriented evidence requests.
_gate_rationale: V3 preserves every accepted V2 baseline gate while doubling the source-grounded corpus from 50 to 100 cases. The live local brain passed these unchanged thresholds on 2026-07-22, so the gate remains the measured production baseline rather than being weakened or recalibrated after the run.
